newsitem.title: USA: UC Television sees Q1 sales above $500,000.
newsitem.headline: UC Television sees Q1 sales above $500,000.

text.p: UC Television Network Corp said Monday it expected sales for its fiscal 1997 first quarter, ended Jan 31, to be over $500,000, a 70 percent increase over sales of $290,963 in the year-earlier period.
The company also said it has received substantial increases from existing advertisers and committments from four new advertisers that amount to $976,000 for fiscal 1997.
The four new advertisers are Doritos, a division of PepsiCo Inc, Polo Jeans, a division of Ralph Lauren. Fruitopia, a Coca-Cola Co unit, and Sony Corp's Columbia Records.
Current advertisers United Parcel Service of America Inc and Grand Metropolitan Plc's GMET.L Burger King Corp unit have doubled their committments for 1997, said the company.
Overall advertising committments for fiscal 1997 to date are 75 percent above fiscal 1996's as of the the same date last year, said UC.
UC Television network is an interactive television network broadcasting news, music and entertainment to college campuses in 40 states.
